# Mainland Ecuador & Galápagos

**Duration:** 18 days / 17 nights  
**Route:** Quito – Amazon – Otavalo – El Ángel – Imbabura – Pululahua – Bellavista – Cotopaxi – Quilotoa – Quito – Galápagos Islands  
**Price:** $10314

## Tour highlights

This 18-day journey combines mainland Ecuador with a 4-day cruise in the Galápagos Islands. You begin with several days in the Amazon before returning to the Andes: Quito, Otavalo, high-altitude El Ángel, the Pululahua crater, Bellavista cloud forest, Cotopaxi and Quilotoa. The final part takes you aboard the M/Y Grand Majestic 5★ yacht to San Cristóbal, Floreana, Española and Santa Cruz.

The programme focuses on nature and wildlife observation. In the Amazon, you explore by canoe and on forest trails, climb towers above the canopy and look for monkeys, birds and caimans. In the Andes, you discover páramo, frailejones, volcanoes and hummingbirds. The Galápagos add sea lions, frigatebirds, blue-footed boobies, albatrosses, flamingos and snorkelling among marine wildlife.
